THREE ORPHAN DECISIONS · pick once and the entire pass becomes mechanical
Each has a recommended slot (zero new files) and a fallback (one new file). My recommendation arrows shown in blue.
→ matches CODATA-2018 within ±0.13 ppb · openly outside CODATA-2022 (compendium acknowledges)

→ proximity match to CODATA mean tropical year (no fitted parameters)

→ ties the coupling residue 4(p−r)² = Δ to the one-pass denominator (pqr−1)
